title: Automotive parts plant, second shift
summary: A maintenance tech's walk of a machining cell: CNC machine, hydraulic press, a locked-out conveyor, a spindle alarm on CNC-07, and a quality check. Shows the same memory working on a plant floor.
style: Unedited first-person snapshot from a head-mounted wearable camera at eye level, deep focus with everything sharp, no bokeh, on an industrial factory floor, slightly off-level framing, mixed overhead sodium and LED lighting, light sensor noise, realistic grime and wear, no people or faces in frame.

shots.prompt: Operator control screen of a CNC machining center, metal chips and coolant behind the window; a large plate above the screen reads "CNC-07"; the screen shows "RUNNING" in green and "SPINDLE 8000 RPM".
Round analog hydraulic pressure gauge on a large industrial press with the needle in the green band; a yellow stenciled label next to it reads "HP-2".
A roller conveyor with a red lockout padlock on its disconnect switch and a red tag reading "LOCKED OUT"; a stenciled sign on the conveyor frame reads "CV-3".

Operator control screen of a CNC machining center, metal chips and coolant behind the window; a large plate above the screen reads "CNC-07"; the screen shows a red banner "ALARM 1012 SPINDLE OVERTEMP".
